name: Morphinan
summary: Morphinan is the prototype chemical structure of a large chemical class of psychoactive drugs, consisting of opiate analgesics, cough suppressants, and dissociative hallucinogens, among others. Typical examples include compounds such as morphine, codeine, and dextromethorphan (DXM).

pharmacology.text: Despite related molecular structures, the pharmacological profiles and mechanisms of action between the various types of morphinan substances can vary substantially.
